title: 第9章 实战
slug: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
lines: 下课铃响。
训练室里的气氛还没散去，不少人三三两两聚在一起，讨论着省赛的事。
“走走走，吃饭去！”
吴志超一把搂住陈峰的肩膀，
“今天食堂一楼有红烧灵鸡腿，我请你，咱哥俩好好聊聊，你小子到底在外面跟谁学的？进步这么猛？”
林远也凑了过来：“对啊峰哥，你那师傅还收不收徒？给兄弟引荐引荐呗。”
陈峰刚要开口，一道清冷的女声从侧面传来。
“陈峰，等一下。”
三人同时转头。
班长冯曦站在两步开外，一头高马尾，身形笔挺修长，整个人显得颇为干净利落。
吴志超和林远对视了一眼。
班长找陈峰？
“你们先等等，我跟他说两句。”
冯曦朝吴志超他们点了点头，语气平淡。
吴志超和林远对视一眼，识趣的往后退了半步。
“冯班长，什么事？”陈峰问。
“耽误你几分钟。”冯曦偏了偏头，示意旁边没人的角落，“单独说。”
陈峰跟着走了过去。
训练室里的人已经走差不多了，只剩几个收拾东西的同学。
冯曦背靠窗台，开口道：
“我想请你这半个月别再旷课了。”
陈峰微微挑眉：“为什么？”
冯曦平静开口：
“下个月有一个校内优秀班干部的评选。”
“评选标准里，班级出勤率占百分之十五的权重，你连续旷课，直接把三班的出勤率拉到了年级倒数。”
她顿了顿。
“我需要这个优秀班干部。”
陈峰听明白了，冯曦目标是保研，这在班里不是秘密。
她从入学第一天起就在卷绩点、卷学分、卷综测排名，每一项加分项都不放过。
优秀班干部能加两个学分，这对她来说确实很重要，而陈峰持续旷课等于在拖她后腿。
“我知道这个要求对你来说有些突然。”
冯曦神色平静，倒是并没有什么居高临下的味道：“所以我愿意给你补偿。”
“两万块。”
“这段时间你正常来上课，我给你转两万块。”
陈峰愣了一下，两万？
这个数字确实出乎他的意料。
冯曦家里条件好他是知道的，但能够为了一个班干部评选直接掏两万块钱，确实令他有些始料未及。
换成一个月前的他，这两万块他可能想都不想就答应了。
但现在……
陈峰在心里盘算了一下。
半个月后就是省赛名额的校内选拔，他现在体质12.0，距离淬体中期的门槛还差整整1点。
单单在学校里上课和训练肯定是来不及的。
他唯一的办法就是在这半个月里反复进入大墟通过采集灵材，把体质提到13。
如果老老实实在学校待半个月，白天上课晚上训练，按部就班，那省赛名额就跟他没关系了。
而省赛前十的奖金最高十万，还有三级助理研究生身份和保研机会，
这些东西加在一起远不是两万块能比的。
“不好意思，班长。”
陈峰摇了摇头，
“这个忙我帮不了。”
冯曦的表情没什么变化，但微微眯了一下眼。
“为什么？”
陈峰神色平静，开口道：“我打算参加半个月后的省赛名额选拔，这段时间，我要专心修行。”
冯曦听完这话，愣了足足两秒，嘴角动了动，似乎想说什么又咽了回去。
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
黑暗褪去，脚下踩实。

    陈峰睁开眼睛，耳膜里的嗡鸣渐渐散干净。

    还是那间三楼的小房间。

    水泥墙壁斑驳，空气里弥漫着霉腐的味道。

    窗外雾气翻涌，苍白月光透进来，照的满地碎玻璃泛着冷光。

    一切和上次离开时一模一样。

    陈峰没有急着动，先站在原地听了十几秒。

    四周一片安静，没有虫子爬动的沙沙声，没有任何异响。

    见状，他这才松了口气，右手抽出工兵铲。

    这一趟进来，他给自己定了两个目标。

    第一是继续采集灵材，把自己所在的整栋楼都探索一遍。

    走廊里的灰伞肺菇上一次已经采光了，但这栋楼总共三层加一个天台，他只探索了三楼和天台。

    下面还有二楼和一楼没去过，以大墟的灵气浓度，下面两层必定还有收获。

    至于第二点，则是想办法获得一些这个世界的信息。

    上一回在天台上远远望见的那个竹竿状的人形怪物，至今还压在他心头。

    二十几米高的身躯，贴着大楼爬行，没有眼睛却能看人。

    那东西到底是什么？

    这个大墟世界到底发生过什么？

    这些问题不搞清楚，他每次进来都跟瞎子摸象一样，迟早要出大事。

    陈峰收拾好心思，侧身贴墙，慢慢挪到房门口，推门出去。

    三楼走廊和上次比没什么变化，碎石、废弃电线、剥落的墙皮，该烂的还烂着。

    他沿着走廊快速扫了一遍，确认没有危险之后，便向着二楼楼梯口走去。

    陈峰摸到楼梯口，先把工兵铲的铲面贴在墙壁上，轻轻敲了三下。

    铛、铛、铛，五秒，十秒，没有铁鄂灰蜚的动静。

    他矮着身子往下走，楼梯拐角处光线更暗了些，夜视仪里的画面泛着淡绿色。

    刚下到二楼平台，陈峰脚步一顿。

    就在楼梯口的墙根处，一株灰伞肺菇安安静静的贴在那里，拇指大小，灰白色菌盖，暗色纹路清晰。

    又是一千块。

    陈峰咧嘴一笑，蹲下身，工兵铲贴着墙根铲过去，连根起出。

    随后塞进个人空间。

    他刚直起身。

    悉悉索索——

    拐角处猛然传来细碎的摩擦声，急促，密集，正在快速靠近。

    陈峰猛然抬头，一只黑灰色的铁鄂灰蜚从二楼走廊的天花板拐角处钻了出来。

    六条粗腿在墙面上疯狂划拉，触须朝着他的方向抖了两下，随即整个虫体脱离墙壁，直直扑了过来！

    陈峰心头微微一紧。

    但他没有后退，也并未掏出白浊喷雾。

    这一次，他并不打算使用外力，而是打算尝试靠自己的力量，来解决铁鄂灰蜚。

    陈峰右脚后撤半步，重心下沉，双手握紧工兵铲，铲面横在胸前。

    眼看铁鄂灰蜚的身体已经到了面前，他腰胯猛的一拧，右臂抡圆，工兵铲的铲面斜着劈出去。

    这是校内兵击格斗课上反复训练过的发力技巧。

    蹬地、转胯、送肩、鞭打。

    力量从脚底传导上来，经过腰腹放大，最后传到手臂末端，层层叠加。

    砰！一声闷响，铲面结结实实拍在铁鄂灰蜚的侧腹。

    二十公斤的虫体被一铲抽飞，横着撞上走廊右侧的墙壁，砸的墙皮哗啦啦往下掉。
content_en:
The darkness fades and the feet are firmly planted.

Chen Feng opened his eyes, and the buzzing in his eardrums gradually disappeared.

It's still the small room on the third floor.

The cement walls are mottled and the air is filled with the smell of mold and rot.

The fog billowed outside the window, and the pale moonlight filtered in, illuminating the broken glass on the ground with a cold light.

Everything is exactly the same as when I left last time.

Chen Feng did not move in a hurry, but stood there and listened for more than ten seconds.

It was quiet all around, without the rustling of insects or any unusual noise.

Seeing this, he breathed a sigh of relief and pulled out the engineer shovel with his right hand.

This time he came in, he set two goals for himself.

The first is to continue collecting spiritual materials and explore the entire building where you are.

The mushrooms in the corridor had been lit up last time, but the building had a total of three floors and a rooftop. He only explored the third floor and the rooftop.

There are two floors below that I haven’t been to yet. With the concentration of spiritual energy in Daxu, there must be something to gain from the two floors below.

As for the second point, it is to find a way to obtain some information about this world.

The bamboo pole-shaped humanoid monster he saw from a distance on the rooftop last time was still weighing on his mind.

The body, which is more than 20 meters tall, crawls close to the building. It has no eyes but can see people.

What is that thing?

What happened in this great ruin world?

If he doesn't understand these issues clearly, he will be like a blind man trying to feel an elephant every time he comes in. Sooner or later something big will happen.

Chen Feng gathered his thoughts, leaned against the wall, slowly moved to the door of the room, opened the door and went out.

The corridor on the third floor remained the same as last time. Rubbles, discarded wires, and peeling walls were all still rotten.

He quickly scanned along the corridor and after confirming that there was no danger, he walked towards the second floor stairs.

Chen Feng reached the stairwell, first put the shovel surface of the engineer's shovel against the wall, and tapped it three times.

Dang, Dang, Dang, five seconds, ten seconds, there is no movement of the iron jaws and gray flies.

He stooped down and walked down. The light became darker at the corner of the stairs, and the picture in the night vision goggles glowed light green.

As soon as he reached the second floor platform, Chen Feng paused.

Just at the foot of the wall at the entrance of the stairs, a P. cinerea sticks quietly there. It is about the size of a thumb, has a gray-white cap, and has clear dark lines.

Another thousand dollars.

Chen Feng grinned, squatted down, shoved the engineer's shovel against the base of the wall, and pulled out the roots.

Then stuff it into your personal space.

He just straightened up.

Xixisuosuo——

A small friction sound suddenly came from around the corner, rapid, dense, and approaching quickly.

Chen Feng suddenly raised his head, and a black-gray iron-jawed worm emerged from the corner of the ceiling of the corridor on the second floor.

Six thick legs scratched wildly on the wall, the tentacles shook twice in his direction, and then the entire insect body broke away from the wall and rushed straight over!

Chen Feng's heart tightened slightly.

But he did not retreat, nor did he take out the white turbid spray.

This time, he does not intend to use external force, but intends to try to rely on his own strength to solve the problem of Tie Jia Hui Fei.

Chen Feng took half a step back with his right foot, his center of gravity sank, and he held the engineering shovel tightly with both hands, holding the shovel flat across his chest.

Seeing that Tie Jia Hui Fei's body was already in front of him, he twisted his waist and hips fiercely, rounded his right arm, and slashed out diagonally with the shovel surface of the engineer shovel.

This is a force-generating technique that has been repeatedly trained in the school's combat classes.

Kick on the ground, turn your hips, send your shoulders, and whip.

The power is transmitted from the soles of the feet, amplified through the waist and abdomen, and finally transmitted to the ends of the arms, layer by layer.

Bang!There was a muffled sound, and the blade of the shovel hit the Iron Jaw Hui Fei's side firmly.

Twenty kilograms of insect bodies were blown away with a shovel and hit the wall on the right side of the corridor, causing the wall to fall down.
